_comment: Hand-authored. The palette table in bank 5.

regions.name: Palettes: 36 x 3 colours
regions.description: Thirty-six palettes of three colours. $B2E4 is the reader and it states the layout exactly: ASL A / ADC $11 / TAX makes X = A * 3, then LDA $B30A,X / LDA $B30B,X / LDA $B30C,X go to $0181,Y / $0182,Y / $0183,Y with Y = the destination index * 3. $0181 is the palette staging area the NMI uploads - $DEF3 walks it reading $0180 for the shared backdrop and $0181,Y upward for the rest - so three bytes here are colours 1, 2 and 3 of a palette and colour 0 comes from $0180. THE EXTENT: $B2E4 is reached through $D92D (entry $C05D), which walks a list of up to eight palette indices ($FE ends it, $FF skips a slot, CPY #$08); every such list in the ROM - the scene records at bank 5 $AE50, the status screen's, and every bank 4 command-4 list - uses indices 0-35 and nothing higher, and 36 x 3 bytes end exactly where set record 6 begins at $B376. CORRECTION: this region was 37 palettes, bounded by 'every byte is a legal colour for exactly 111 bytes'; the 37th 'palette' was the first three bytes of set record 6 (07 11 00), which happen to be legal colours. HARDWARE: two savestates hold exactly records 0-3 in sprite palette RAM. Which palette is used where is in tools/tgl/scene.py.
